name: couchview
description: A compact local-first Git diff review PWA powered by Bun.

scripts.format: biome check --write --linter-enabled=false src/client/App.tsx src/client/components src/client/features src/client/lib scripts/checkArchitecture.ts scripts/checkArchitecture.test.ts .codex/hooks/checkArchitecture.ts biome.jsonc package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: biome check --linter-enabled=false src/client/App.tsx src/client/components src/client/features src/client/lib scripts/checkArchitecture.ts scripts/checkArchitecture.test.ts .codex/hooks/checkArchitecture.ts .codex/hooks.json biome.jsonc package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts tests .codex/hooks vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome lint --write --unsafe src scripts tests .codex/hooks vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.check:architecture: bun run scripts/checkArchitecture.ts && biome lint --only=lint/suspicious/noImportCycles src scripts .codex/hooks
scripts.check:quality: bun run check:architecture && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test src scripts && bun run build
